articles.title: Bitcoin hits $82,000, Coinbase leads crypto stock gains as Clarity Act advances
articles.snippet: The upbeat public debut of AI chipmaker Cerebras is also helping to lift both crypto and traditional markets.

articles.title: Turnkey raises $12.5 million in round backed by Circle Ventures and Sequoia Capital
articles.snippet: The new capital will primarily fund the development and public launch of Turnkey Verifiable Cloud, a secure computing product for digital assets.

articles.title: BitGo posts wider Q1 loss despite revenue more than doubling
articles.snippet: BitGo’s headline revenue figure doubled year-over-year to $3.8 billion, but a Bitcoin price decline and IPO-related costs pushed net losses to $60.7 million in the first quarter.

articles.title: Trump’s White House weighs 250 pardons to celebrate America's 250th birthday
articles.snippet: One of the developers behind the crypto-mixing protocol Samourai Wallet has publicly expressed hopes for a pardon, along with FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried.

articles.title: Tether, Tron and TRM Financial Crime Unit Has Frozen $450 Million in Illicit Crypto Funds
articles.snippet: A public-private partnership among Tether, Tron, and TRM Labs is expanding its global reach, working with law enforcement in 23 countries.
